hooks.name: Run codec tests on save
hooks.description: Runs the Vitest codec test suite whenever a file under /web/src/codec is saved and reports how many property tests pass.

action.prompt: A file under /web/src/codec was just saved. Run the codec test suite with: cd web && npx vitest run src/codec --reporter=verbose 2>&1. Then report: (1) overall pass/fail, (2) which of the six property tests (PT-1 through PT-6) passed and which failed, (3) any type errors or import violations (codec importing from UI or camera APIs). Keep the report short — one line per property test, then a brief summary.
